title: 第三章 F2出场第四章 找一个替身
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
许见娟能想到的事情，简妤自然也能想到。
按照剧情，盛越对许见娟产生兴趣，跟林教授这节课有很大关系。
眼下，女主态度有点奇怪，简妤不敢再吃瓜，只想离对方远一点。
本来想洗漱的时候，磨蹭一下，等许见娟离开。
嘿，没想到这女主还挺有耐心。
简妤害怕迟到，只能甘拜下风。
许见娟看见她出来，挽了挽耳边的碎发，浑身都在试图释放善意，“简妤，我。”
“我不喝白茶，我喜欢奶绿加啵啵。”简妤扶了下镜框，没头没尾地来了句。
四目相对，许见娟眼神迷惑。
好烦。女主看不懂她在拒绝好友位，也听不懂她的人话。
简妤抱紧书本，撒腿就跑。
小胳膊小腿，跑得七五八六的，毫无美感，跟见鬼一样。
许见娟：“……”
气喘吁吁跑到教室，才七点半，人就快坐满了一半。
林教授不愧是林教授。
哦，不对。
应该说，F2果然吓人。
简妤记得林教授很喜欢抓人回答问题，特别是坐在偏僻座位上的同学。
避免被提问，她特意找了比较中间的后排位置坐。
没办法，前排都被占光了。

紊乱的气息，慢慢恢复正常，简妤捂了捂发疼的心脏。
下次不能跑那么快了。
也不能熬夜。
要养生。
早产，心脏病，弃养在孤儿院，简直就是现实版本的自己。
要是能觉醒兽魂就好了，先进的医学依旧解决不了心脏病，但兽魂可以。
兽魂太少见，大部分只存在贵族阶级，不是她一个路人甲该有的。
简妤轻轻地呼了口气，打开书，心思却没在书上。
她确定以及肯定，她被女主盯上了。
可能是想跟她做朋友？但最可能的，应该是想拉她一起当靶子，帮忙吸引火力。
“简妤，我可以坐这里吗？”许见娟阴魂不散地出现。
简妤抬起眼睛，面无表情地看着面前的小可爱，“你坐吧。”
许见娟开心地坐下。
简妤则是立马起身，抱起书，坐到墙角靠窗的座位上。
content_en:
What Xu Jianjuan can think of, Jian Yu can naturally think of.
According to the plot, Sheng Yue's interest in Xu Jianjuan has a lot to do with Professor Lin's class.
At the moment, the heroine's attitude is a bit strange. Jian Yu doesn't dare to eat anymore, she just wants to stay away from her.
When I originally wanted to wash up, I waited for Xu Jianjuan to leave.
Hey, I didn’t expect this heroine to be quite patient.
Jian Yu was afraid of being late, so she could only accept the defeat.
Xu Jianjuan saw her coming out and tugged the broken hair around her ears, trying to express her kindness all over, "Jian Yu, me."
"I don't drink white tea, I like milk green with pops of tea." Jian Yu held up the frame of the glasses and said in a confused tone.
Their eyes met, Xu Jianjuan's eyes were confused.
So annoying. The heroine couldn't understand that she was rejecting the friend status, nor could she understand her human words.
Jian Yu hugged the book tightly and ran away.
His little arms and legs were running wildly, without any sense of beauty, as if he had seen a ghost.
Xu Jianjuan: "..."
I ran to the classroom out of breath. It was only half past seven and it was almost half full.
Professor Lin is indeed Professor Lin.
Oh, no.
It should be said that F2 is really scary.
Jian Yu remembered that Professor Lin liked to catch people to answer questions, especially students sitting in remote seats.
To avoid being asked questions, she deliberately found a seat in the middle of the back row.
There is no way, the front row is all occupied.
The chaotic breath slowly returned to normal, and Jian Yu covered her aching heart.
I can't run so fast next time.
You can't stay up late either.
To maintain health.
Premature birth, heart disease, abandoned in an orphanage, it is simply the real version of myself.
It would be great if the beast soul could be awakened. Advanced medicine still cannot solve heart disease, but the beast soul can.
Beast souls are too rare. Most of them only exist in the aristocratic class. They are not something she, a passerby, should have.
Jian Yu breathed out softly and opened the book, but her mind was not on the book.
She was sure and certain that she was being targeted by the heroine.
Maybe you want to be friends with her? But most likely, he wanted to use her as a target to help attract firepower.
"Jian Yu, can I sit here?" Xu Jianjuan appeared hauntingly.
Jian Yu raised her eyes and looked at the cutie in front of her expressionlessly, "Sit down."
Xu Jianjuan sat down happily.
Jian Yu stood up immediately, picked up the book, and sat on the corner seat by the window.
